answer: The velvet graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the garden audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 9 times its size, so a group of 43 keys loses far more than 43 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the dune checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
